integrity.derivation: Analytical proof of support representation, sharp cap-inclusion thresholds and local edge asymptotics.
integrity.provenance: No claim of third-party certification or independent validation.
integrity.reproducibility: Standard-library checker supplied; all substantive statements tied to explicit proof steps.

scientific_limitations: The exact CDF is given only on the upper interval from brightness 14 through the maximum, plus a lower-end asymptotic; no complete elementary middle CDF is asserted.

General formulas for polyhedral random-width densities already exist and may partially subsume methods; a highly relevant long preprint was accessible only as abstract and metadata, so publication priority is not independently settled.
Finite numerical projected-hull and sampling tests corroborate but do not prove continuum statements.
title: Sharp two-edge brightness law for the regular truncated octahedron
